description: No critical or high vulnerabilities found in frontend dependencies during automated scan.
No critical or high vulnerabilities found in backend dependencies during automated scan.
No exposed API keys or hardcoded JWT secrets found during automated scan.
Insufficient input validation on email and password in the register function. No regex format check for email and no complexity/length check for password.
actionable_fix: Implement strict input validation using a library like Joi or Zod to validate email format, enforce minimum password length (e.g., 8 chars), and sanitize whitespace.

description: Potential prompt injection surface. The buildPrompt function directly interpolates user profile inputs (like fitness_goal, target_weight_kg) into the LLM system prompt without strict length or sanitization checks.
actionable_fix: Add strict length limits and character filtering on all user-controlled text fields before saving to the DB or before building the prompt. Prevent injection payloads like 'Ignore all previous instructions'.

description: Codebase was audited for N+1 query patterns inside loops or Promise.all structures. No N+1 query loops were detected; queries are executed efficiently without batching problems.
Backend dependencies were audited. Standard packages (express, pg, bcryptjs, passport) are used without unnecessary bloat.
Frontend dependencies were audited. Modern, lightweight packages (date-fns, react-hook-form, zod, tanstack-query) are in use. No legacy bloat (e.g., moment.js, lodash) was found.
